name: zinterp_context_expand_macro_refs
description: zInterp_Context::ExpandMacroRefs substitutes paired %NAME% references through the macro table into the shared interpreter expansion scratch buffer.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja renders the macroName terminator write at 0x4c12ee as a neighboring stack artifact and renders rep movs append loops as memcpy-style helpers; assembly review confirms stack macroName termination and string append behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1250 validates null input returning null, missing or incomplete % delimiter pairs returning the original buffer, paired macro expansion through FindMacroValue, undefined macro stripping, and returning g_zInterp_MacroExpansionScratch for expanded inputs.
The native smoke verifies no-macro and missing-close original-buffer returns, two macro replacements, undefined macro stripping, and retaining trailing unmatched text after a valid expansion.
